'''2022 EGP Matt Wadden LS Qui Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wadden]] at [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Wadden]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing|V16-L-communing.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|I Am Part Of The Living Force|V16-L-iampartofthelivingforce.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Communing Wadden LS 2022 EGP.txt |Download]]
